decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned on the website, which points to a peripheral product, and the quick exit from mining vehicles shows management drops vehicle lines that miss aspirations, but without evidence of failure the low cost of keeping it argues for retention.

The inclined furniture lift has its own page and looks like the core of the firm's refocus after the mining products were dropped, so it likely meets aspirations in a stable niche well served by German firms.
The building material lift shares technology and customers with the furniture lift, so it adds little cost and fits the firm's lift portfolio, which makes dropping it unlikely.
The truck-mounted lift extends the lift line and has its own page, but it is more capital-intensive and faces strong competition, so some risk remains if results fall short and slack is limited.
